title: fix(ui): display labels for lazy copy values
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Use the field label when a lazy copy value has no explicit display; preserve string values, empty displays and ReactNode overrides.
- Leave the original function passed to CopyButton unchanged, so sync/async values are evaluated only on a copy click; document the fallback.
- Extend existing composition SSR tests for output and non-evaluation; bump UI to alpha.6 with only its workspace lock entry.
- Validation: original regression fails; all 110 UI tests, typecheck, full build and changed-file Biome pass. Parent regression passes; browser clipboard interaction was not exercised.

Fixes #16486

gist.headline: A label worth copying
gist.blurb: Lazy copy fields get a readable label while their value waits for the actual copy click. Even the clipboard gets to respect boundaries.
gist.summary: CopyField in packages/ui alpha.6 uses the field label when a lazy copy value has no explicit display, while preserving string, empty, and ReactNode displays and evaluating sync or async values only on copy.
gist.impact: People see the field label instead of a blank lazy copy field; copying still resolves the value only when clicked.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy UI workbench with a clearly labeled CopyField and a clipboard button. Polli points to the visible label while a closed little box represents the lazy value waiting for a click; code-plants and flowers soften the scene. No external project mascot is indicated.
